cues: Evans climbs into the hole and heaves out a heavy bar; a little thorn pricks his hand.
He pulls it out and carries on, piling ingots on his jacket.
He grows irritable, his arms ache, the forest feels stuffy, he snaps at Hooker.
Then he stumbles, clutches his throat, and slides down a tree.
And as Hooker gathers up the gold, he feels a little prick on the ball of his thumb.
text: Now watch the thorns. Evans climbs into the hole and heaves out a heavy bar; a little thorn pricks his hand. He pulls it out and carries on, piling ingots on his jacket. Another little thorn. He grows irritable, his arms ache, the forest feels stuffy, he snaps at Hooker. Then he stumbles, clutches his throat, and slides down a tree. And as Hooker gathers up the gold, he feels a little prick on the ball of his thumb.
